segments.he: גַּם אָנֹכִי פּוֹרֵס שְׁלוֹמְךָ בְּאַהֲבָה רַבָּה, קֹדֶם פֶּסַח שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ בַּאֲרִיכוּת קְצָת וְאַחַר־כָּךְ קִבַּלְתִּי מִכְתָּבְךָ מֵחֻתֶּנְךָ רַבִּי יוֹאֵל, נֵרוֹ־יָאִיר, וְתָמַהְתִי שֶׁלֹּא קִבַּלְתָּ מִכְתָּבִי, וְיוֹתֵר מִזֶּה אֲנִי מִתְפַּלֵּא עָלֶיךָ שֶׁלֹּא קִבַּלְתִּי מִכְתָּבְךָ כִּי־אִם פַּעַם אַחַת, וּמֵחֲמַת זֶה מָנַעְתָּ הַטּוֹב מִלִּנְטוֹת יָדִי אֵלֶיךָ, וְגַם מֵחֲמַת שֶׁבַּחֹרֶף הֶעָבַר הָיִיתִי מוּטָל עַל עֶרֶשׂ־דְּוַי בְּאוּמַאן וְנִתְעַכַּבְתִּי שָׁם מֵחֲמַת זֶה יוֹתֵר מֵחֲמִשָּׁה שָׁבוּעוֹת, וְאַחַר־כָּךְ הָיִיתִי בְּטִירָהאוִויצֶע וְנִתְמַהְמַהְתִּי בְּהַדֶּרֶךְ יוֹתֵר מִשִּׁבְעָה שָׁבוּעוֹת, וְלֹא רָאִיתִי שָׁם שׁוּב מִכְתָּב מֵאִתְּךָ, וְאָבִיךָ יְדִידֵנוּ נֵרוֹ יָאִיר, כָּלוּ עֵינָיו מִיַּחֵל לְמִכְתָּבֶיךָ וְתוֹחַלְתּוֹ נִכְזְבָה, וּבֶאֱמֶת אֵין אַתָּה יוֹצֵא יְדֵי חוֹבַת אָבִיךָ בְּעִנְיָן זֶה כְּלָל.

segments.he: וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּאתִי לְבֵיתִי בַּחֲלִישׁוּת כֹּחַ וּמָצָאתִי מִכְתָּבְךָ בְּיַד רַבִּי נָתָן בֶּן רַבִּי לֵיבּ שֶׁנִּכְתַּב לִפְנֵי כַּמָּה שָׁבוּעוֹת וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי אָז הֵיכָן אַתָּה, וַאֲנִי בָּאתִי לְבֵיתִי סָמוּךְ לְפוּרִים, וּבֵין פּוּרִים לְפֶסַח שָׁלַחְתִּי לְךָ מִכְתָּבִי הַנַּ"ל וַעֲדַיִן אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ אִם הִגִּיעַ לְיָדְךָ, וְכָעֵת אֵין לְהוֹסִיף עַל אִגֶּרֶת הַנַּ"ל רַק לְקַיֵּם מַה שֶׁכָּתַבְתִּי שָׁם לִשְׁלֹחַ לִי מֵאִתְּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הִבְטַחְתָּ בְּמִכְתָּבְךָ עַל־יְדֵי רַבִּי נָתָן הַנַּ"ל, וְגַם לְהִשְׁתַּדֵּל בְּכָל מַה דְּאֶפְשָׁר לְקַבֵּל אֵצֶל אַנְשֵׁי־שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ וּבִפְרָט אֵצֶל יְדִידִי רַבִּי צְבִי בר"מ בֶּערְגֶּער וְאֵצֶל יְדִידִי רַבִּי לֶיבְּלֶי בֶּן רַבִּי חַייקְל, וּמֻבְטְחַנִי שֶׁתִּשְׁתַּדֵּל לְטוֹבָתִי עַל צַד הַיּוֹתֵר טוֹב בְּכָל מַה דְּאֶפְשָׁר, וְה' הַטּוֹב יִגְמֹר בַּעַדְךָ לְטוֹבָה.
segments.en: And afterwards he came home in weakness of strength — and found his letter in the hand of Rabbi Nussun son of Rabbi Leib — written some weeks before — and he did not know then where he was. And he arrived home close to Purim — and between Purim and Pesach he sent him the above-mentioned letter — and still he does not know whether it reached his hand. And now there is nothing to add to the above-mentioned letter — only to fulfil what he wrote there — to send him money from himself or from others — as much as possible. And to strive in all that is possible to receive from the anshei sh'lomaynu — and in particular from his friend Rabbi Tzvi bar-M. Berger — and from his friend Rabbi Leibele son of Rabbi Chaikl. And he is confident that he will strive for his good on the very best side — in all that is possible — and may the Good Hashem complete for him for good.

segments.he: וְאוֹדוֹת מַה שֶּׁכָּתַבְתָּ לִמְחוּתָּנְךָ שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, שֶׁיַּקְדִּים הַנִּשּׂוּאִין מֵהַזְּמַן הֻגְבָּל בְּהַתְּנָאִים, כְּבָר הֵשִׁיב לְךָ שֶׁהוּא דָּבָר שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר, וּכְבָר הָיָה בְּבֵיתִי וְהִתְנַצֵּל עַצְמוֹ הַרְבֵּה, וְאָמַר שֶׁבַּזְּמַן הַמֻגְבָּל יַעֲשֶׂה הַנִּשּׂוּאִין בְּעֶזְרַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, וְאֶפְשָׁר יַקְדִּים עַצְמוֹ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בְּחֹדֶשׁ אֱלוּל הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, וְדַעְתִי הוּא שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּלִי תֵּרוּץ לְפֹה עַל חַג הַשָּׁבוּעוֹת הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, וְאָז יֻגְמַר הַכֹּל בְּכִי טוֹבָה, וְגַם הַסַּךְ חֲמִשִּׁים רוּבָּל שֶׁכְּבָר סִלֵּק מֻנָּח הַשְּׁלִישׁוּת בִּידֵי מִבְטוֹחַ גָּדוֹל, אַךְ כְּבָר הִגִּיעַ הַזְמַן פֵּרָעוֹן וַאֲנִי אֵינִי רוֹצֶה עוֹד לַעֲסֹק בָּזֶה וְאֵינִי רוֹצֶה לְהַשְׁלִישׁ הַשְּׁלִישׁוּת, עַד שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּעַצְמְךָ וְתַשְׁלִישׁ אֵצֶל מִי שֶׁתִּרְצֶה, הֵן עַל כָּל אֵלֶּה אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי עַתָּה לְהַרְחִיב הַדִּבּוּר רַק תִּרְאֶה לְקַיֵּם דְּבָרַי הַנַּ"ל, לִשְׁלֹחַ לִי מָעוֹת מֵאִתְּךָ אוֹ מֵאֲחֵרִים כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁתּוּכַל, וְאַחַר־כָּךְ תְּזָרֵז עַצְמְךָ לְהָכִין עַצְמֶךָ בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁתָּבוֹא לְפֹה עַל חַג הַשָּׁבוּעוֹת הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה וְיִהְיֶה טוֹב לְפָנֶיךָ בְּכָל הָאֳפָנִים בְּגוּף וְנֶפֶשׁ וּמָמוֹן. וּבְעִנְיַן טוֹבַת הַזּוּג שֶׁיִּחְיוּ, וּבַעַל הַיְשׁוּעוֹת וְהַנֶּחָמוֹת יְנַחֵם וְיוֹשִׁיעַ אוֹתְךָ בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת וְרוּחָנִיּוּת בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁתִּזְכֶּה לִבְרֹחַ וּלְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ מִכָּל מַה שֶּׁעוֹבֵר עָלֶיךָ עַד שֶׁיִּתְהַפֵּךְ הַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה.
segments.en: And regarding what he wrote to his son-in-law — may he live — to advance the wedding from the time fixed in the tennaim: he has already replied to him that it is impossible — and already he was in his house and made many excuses — and said that at the fixed time he will make the wedding with Hashem's help — and perhaps he will advance himself so that it will be in the month of Elul coming upon them for good. And his mind is that he should come without excuse here for the holy festival of Shavuos coming upon them for good — and then everything will be completed for the best. And the sum of fifty rubles — that he already paid — one third is held in trust by a great guarantor — but the time of payment has already arrived — and he no longer wants to deal with this — and he does not want to place the deposit — until he comes himself and places it with whom he wishes. On all these matters there are no words in his tongue now to extend the conversation — only let him see to fulfil the above-mentioned words — to send him money from himself or from others — as much as he can — and afterwards hurry to prepare himself in a way that he comes here for the holy festival of Shavuos — and it will be good before him in all ways — in body and soul and money. And in the matter of the good of the couple — may they live — and may the Master of salvations and consolations console and save him in the physical and the spiritual — in a way that he merits to flee and to draw close to Him Yisborach — from all that passes over him — until all is turned to good.
segments.he_nikud: וְאוֹדוֹת מַה שֶּׁכָּתַבְתָּ לִמְחֻוֽתָּנְךָ שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, שֶׁיַּקְדִּים הַנִּשּׂוּאִין מֵהַזְּמַן הַגַּבָּל בְּהַתְּנָאִים, כְּבָר הֵשִׁיב לְךָ שֶׁהוּא דָּבָר שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר, וּכְבָר הָיָה בְּבֵיתִי וְהִתְנַצֵּל עַצְמוֹ הַרְבֵּה, וְאָמַר שֶׁבִּזְמַן הַמְגַבֵּל יַעֲשֶׂה הַנִּשּׂוּאִין בְּעֶזְרַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, וְאֶפְשָׁר יַקְדִּים עַצְמוֹ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בְּחֹדֶשׁ אֱלוּל הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, וְדַעְתִּי הוּא שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּלִי תָּרוּץ לַפֶּה עַל חַג הַשָּׁבוּעוֹת הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, וְאָז יִגָּמֵר הַכֹּל בְּכִי טוֹבָה, וְגַם הַסַּךְ חֲמִשִּׁים רוּבָּל שֶׁכְּבָר סִלֵּק מַנַּח הַשָּׁלִישׁוּת בְּיָדִי מִבָּטוּחַ גָּדוֹל, אַךְ כְּבָר הִגִּיעַ הַזְּמַן פֵּרָעוֹן וַאֲנִי אֵינִי רוֹצֶה עוֹד לְעֵסֶק בָּזֶה וְאֵינִי רוֹצֶה לְהַשְׁלִישׁ הַשָּׁלִישׁוּת, עַד שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּעַצְמְךָ וְתַשְׁלִישׁ אֵצֶל מִי שֶׁתִּרְצֶה, הֵן עַל כָּל אֵלֶּה אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי עַתָּה לְהַרְחִיב הַדִּבּוּר רַק תִּרְאֶה לְקַיֵּם דְּבָרַי הַנָּ"ל, לְשַׁלַּח לִי מָעוֹת מֵאִתְּךָ אוֹ מֵאֲחֵרִים כְּפִי מַה שֶׁתּוּכַל, וְאַחֲרַכְּךָ תְּזָרֵז עַצְמְךָ לְהָכִין עַצְמְךָ בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁתָּבוֹא לַפֶּה עַל חַג הַשָּׁבוּעוֹת הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה וְיִהְיֶה טוֹב לְפָנֶיךָ בְּכָל הָאֳפָנִים בְּגוּף וְנֶפֶשׁ וּמָמוֹן. וּבְעִנְיַן טוֹבַת הַזּוּג שֶׁיִּחְיוּ, וּבַעַל הַיְּשׁוּעוֹת וְהַנֶּחָמוֹת יִנָּחֵם וְיוֹשִׁיעַ אוֹתְךָ בַּגַּשְׁמִיּוּת וְרוּחָנִיּוֹת בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁתִּזְכֶּה לִבְרֹחַ וּלְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו יִתְבָּרֵךְ מִכָּל מַה שֶׁעוֹבֵר עָלֶיךָ עַד שֶׁיִּתְהַפֵּךְ הַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה.

segments.he: וְיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה הַרְבֵּה לְדַבֵּר אַךְ אֵין הַזְּמַן וְהַיְרִיעָה מַסְפֶּקֶת, וְגַם כִּי אֲנִי מְצַפֶּה שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּעַצְמְךָ אִם יִרְצֶה הַשֵּׁם כַּנַּ"ל, וְאָז פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים נְדַבֵּר בִּישׁוּעוֹת ה' כְּכָל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲמֹס לָנוּ חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא תָמְנוּ וְכוּ' נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ.
segments.en: And there is much much to speak about this — but the time and the page do not suffice. And he is hoping that he will come himself — if Hashem wills — as above — and then face to face they will speak in the salvations of Hashem — as much as His chesed and His wonders will bestow upon them — which have not ceased — nagila v'nismecha bishu'aso.
segments.he_nikud: וְיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה הַרְבֵּה לְדָבָר אַךְ אֵין הַזְּמַן וְהַיְּרִיעָה מַסְפֶּקֶת, וְגַם כִּי אֲנִי מְצַפֶּה שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּעַצְמְךָ אִם יִרְצֶה הַשֵּׁם כַּנַ"ל, וְאָז פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים נְדַבֵּר בִּישׁוּעוֹת ה' כְּכָל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲמָס לָנוּ חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא תָּמְנוּ וְכוּ' נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ.

segments.he: דִּבְרֵי אוֹהֲבוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת לָנֶצַח וּמְצַפֶּה לִתְשׁוּבָתוֹ תְּחִלָּה וְאַחַר כָּךְ לִרְאוֹתוֹ מְהֵרָה בְּשִׂמְחָה.
segments.en: The words of one who loves him in truth forever — and awaits his response first — and afterwards to see him quickly in joy.
segments.he_nikud: דִּבְרֵי אוֹהֲבוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת לָנֶצַח וּמְצַפֶּה לִתְשׁוּבָתוֹ תְּחִלָּה וְאַחַר כָּךְ לִרְאוֹתוֹ מְהֵרָה בְּשִׂמְחָה.

segments.he: וְשָׁלוֹם רַב לְכָל בְּנֵי־בֵיתוֹ וְלִבְנוֹ הֶחָתָן שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, וּלְחוֹתְנוֹ יְדִידִי נֵרוֹ יָאִיר, גַּם הוּא יְקַיֵּם לִשְׁלֹחַ אֵיזֶה סַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתַבְתִּי בָּאִגֶּרֶת הַקָּדוּם, וְשָׁלוֹם לְכָל אַנְשֵׁי־שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ הַיְקָרִים בְּאַהֲבָה רַבָּה, כָּל מַה שֶּׁיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׁלַח רַק לִקְהִלַּת טוּלְטְשִׁין לִבְנִי רַבִּי יִצְחָק שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, וְגַם הָאִגֶּרֶת הַזֶּה אָנוּ שׁוֹלְחִים לְטוּלְטְשִׁין בִּכְדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בָּטוּחַ שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ לְיָדָם בְּעֶזְרַת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ.
segments.en: And great peace to all his household and to his son the bridegroom — may he live. And to his father-in-law his dear friend — may his light shine — also he should fulfil to send some sum as he wrote in the earlier letter. And peace to all the precious anshei sh'lomaynu with great love. All that he sends — let him send only to the congregation of Tultchin — to his son Rabbi Yitzchok — may he live. And also this letter is being sent to Tultchin — so that it should certainly arrive in their hands — with Hashem's help. Overview: Written to one of the anshei sh'lomaynu — beginning missing — 5601. He extends his peace with great love. Before Pesach he sent him a letter at some length — and afterwards received his letter via his son-in-law Rabbi Yoel. He wonders that he received his letter only once — and because of this he held back from extending his hand to him for good. And also because in the past winter he was confined to bed in Uman for more than five weeks — and afterwards he was in Tirahowitz — and on the road for more than seven weeks — and saw no further letter from him there. And his father — their dear friend — his eyes were longing for his letters — and his hope was disappointed — and in truth he is not fulfilling his obligation to his father in this matter at all. He arrived home close to Purim — and between Purim and Pesach he sent him the above-mentioned letter. Now there is nothing to add — only to fulfil what he wrote — to send him money from himself or from others. And regarding what he wrote about advancing the wedding from the fixed time in the tennaim — it is impossible. His mind is that he should come without excuse here for the holy festival of Shavuos — and then everything will be completed for the best. And he no longer wants to deal with the deposit until he comes himself and places it with whom he wishes. And he is hoping that he will come himself — and face to face they will speak in the salvations of Hashem — nagila v'nismecha bishu'aso.
segments.he_nikud: וְשָׁלוֹם רַב לְכָל בְּנִיֽבֵּיתוֹ וְלִבְנוֹ הֶחָתָן שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, וּלְחוֹתְנוֹ יְדִידִי נֵרוֹ יָאִיר, גַּם הוּא יָקִים לִשְׁלֹחַ אֵיזֶה סַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתַבְתִּי בְּאִגֶּרֶת הַקָּדוּם, וְשָׁלוֹם לְכָל אֲנַשֵׁישְׁלוּמֵנוּ הַיְּקָרִים בְּאַהֲבָה רַבָּה, כָּל מַה שֶׁיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׁלַח רַק לִקְהִלַּת טוּלְטְשִׁין לִבְנִי רַבִּי יִצְחָק שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, וְגַם הָאִגֶּרֶת הַזֶּה אָנוּ שׁוֹלְחִים לְטוּלְטְשִׁין בִּכְדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בָּטוּחַ שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ לְיָדָם בְּעֶזְרַת ה' יִתְבָּרֵךְ.

aligned_segments.he: שמט
aligned_segments.en: And also I extend his peace with great love. Before Pesach he sent him a letter at some length — and afterwards received his letter via his son-in-law Rabbi Yoel — may his light shine. And he wonders that he did not receive his letter — and even more than this he wonders at him — that he received his letter only once. And because of this he held back from extending his hand to him for good — and also because in the past winter he was confined to bed in Uman — more than five weeks — and afterwards he was in Tirahowitz — and he was delayed on the road more than seven weeks — and he saw no further letter from him there. And his father — their dear friend — may his light shine — his eyes were longing for his letters — and his hope was disappointed. And in truth he is not fulfilling his obligation to his father in this matter at all.

aligned_segments.he: נִכְתַּב לְאֶחָד מֵאַנְשֵׁי־שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ וְחָסֵר הַהַתְחָלָה.

And he wonders that he did not receive his letter — and even more than this he wonders at him — that he received his letter only once. And because of this he held back from extending his hand to him for good — and also because in the past winter he was confined to bed in Uman — more than five weeks — and afterwards he was in Tirahowitz — and he was delayed on the road more than seven weeks — and he saw no further letter from him there. And his father — their dear friend — may his light shine — his eyes were longing for his letters — and his hope was disappointed. And in truth he is not fulfilling his obligation to his father in this matter at all.

aligned_segments.he: גַּם אָנֹכִי פּוֹרֵס שְׁלוֹמְךָ בְּאַהֲבָה רַבָּה,, קֹדֶם פֶּסַח שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ בַּאֲרִיכוּת קְצָת וְאַחַר־כָּךְ קִבַּלְתִּי מִכְתָּבְךָ מֵחֻתֶּנְךָ רַבִּי יוֹאֵל,
aligned_segments.en: And also I extend his peace with great love.

aligned_segments.he: נֵרוֹ־יָאִיר,, וְתָמַהְתִי שֶׁלֹּא קִבַּלְתָּ מִכְתָּבִי,, וְיוֹתֵר מִזֶּה אֲנִי מִתְפַּלֵּא עָלֶיךָ שֶׁלֹּא קִבַּלְתִּי מִכְתָּבְךָ כִּי־אִם פַּעַם אַחַת,
aligned_segments.en: Before Pesach he sent him a letter at some length — and afterwards received his letter via his son-in-law Rabbi Yoel — may his light shine.

aligned_segments.he: וּמֵחֲמַת זֶה מָנַעְתָּ הַטּוֹב מִלִּנְטוֹת יָדִי אֵלֶיךָ,, וְגַם מֵחֲמַת שֶׁבַּחֹרֶף הֶעָבַר הָיִיתִי מוּטָל עַל עֶרֶשׂ־דְּוַי בְּאוּמַאן וְנִתְעַכַּבְתִּי שָׁם מֵחֲמַת זֶה יוֹתֵר מֵחֲמִשָּׁה שָׁבוּעוֹת,
aligned_segments.en: And he wonders that he did not receive his letter — and even more than this he wonders at him — that he received his letter only once.

aligned_segments.he: וְאַחַר־כָּךְ הָיִיתִי בְּטִירָהאוִויצֶע וְנִתְמַהְמַהְתִּי בְּהַדֶּרֶךְ יוֹתֵר מִשִּׁבְעָה שָׁבוּעוֹת,, וְלֹא רָאִיתִי שָׁם שׁוּב מִכְתָּב מֵאִתְּךָ,
aligned_segments.en: And because of this he held back from extending his hand to him for good — and also because in the past winter he was confined to bed in Uman — more than five weeks — and afterwards he was in Tirahowitz — and he was delayed on the road more than seven weeks — and he saw no further letter from him there.

aligned_segments.he: וְאָבִיךָ יְדִידֵנוּ נֵרוֹ יָאִיר,, כָּלוּ עֵינָיו מִיַּחֵל לְמִכְתָּבֶיךָ וְתוֹחַלְתּוֹ נִכְזְבָה,, וּבֶאֱמֶת אֵין אַתָּה יוֹצֵא יְדֵי חוֹבַת אָבִיךָ בְּעִנְיָן זֶה כְּלָל.
aligned_segments.en: And his father — their dear friend — may his light shine — his eyes were longing for his letters — and his hope was disappointed. And in truth he is not fulfilling his obligation to his father in this matter at all.

aligned_segments.he: וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּאתִי לְבֵיתִי בַּחֲלִישׁוּת כֹּחַ וּמָצָאתִי מִכְתָּבְךָ בְּיַד רַבִּי נָתָן בֶּן רַבִּי לֵיבּ שֶׁנִּכְתַּב לִפְנֵי כַּמָּה שָׁבוּעוֹת וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי אָז הֵיכָן אַתָּה,
aligned_segments.en: And afterwards he came home in weakness of strength — and found his letter in the hand of Rabbi Nussun son of Rabbi Leib — written some weeks before — and he did not know then where he was.

aligned_segments.he: וַאֲנִי בָּאתִי לְבֵיתִי סָמוּךְ לְפוּרִים,, וּבֵין פּוּרִים לְפֶסַח שָׁלַחְתִּי לְךָ מִכְתָּבִי הַנַּ"ל וַעֲדַיִן אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ אִם הִגִּיעַ לְיָדְךָ,
aligned_segments.en: And he arrived home close to Purim — and between Purim and Pesach he sent him the above-mentioned letter — and still he does not know whether it reached his hand.

aligned_segments.he: וְכָעֵת אֵין לְהוֹסִיף עַל אִגֶּרֶת הַנַּ"ל רַק לְקַיֵּם מַה שֶׁכָּתַבְתִּי שָׁם לִשְׁלֹחַ לִי מֵאִתְּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הִבְטַחְתָּ בְּמִכְתָּבְךָ עַל־יְדֵי רַבִּי נָתָן הַנַּ"ל,
aligned_segments.en: And now there is nothing to add to the above-mentioned letter — only to fulfil what he wrote there — to send him money from himself or from others — as much as possible.

aligned_segments.he: וְגַם לְהִשְׁתַּדֵּל בְּכָל מַה דְּאֶפְשָׁר לְקַבֵּל אֵצֶל אַנְשֵׁי־שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ וּבִפְרָט אֵצֶל יְדִידִי רַבִּי צְבִי בר"מ בֶּערְגֶּער וְאֵצֶל יְדִידִי רַבִּי לֶיבְּלֶי בֶּן רַבִּי חַייקְל,
aligned_segments.en: And to strive in all that is possible to receive from the anshei sh'lomaynu — and in particular from his friend Rabbi Tzvi bar-M.

aligned_segments.he: וּמֻבְטְחַנִי שֶׁתִּשְׁתַּדֵּל לְטוֹבָתִי עַל צַד הַיּוֹתֵר טוֹב בְּכָל מַה דְּאֶפְשָׁר,, וְה' הַטּוֹב יִגְמֹר בַּעַדְךָ לְטוֹבָה.
aligned_segments.en: Berger — and from his friend Rabbi Leibele son of Rabbi Chaikl. And he is confident that he will strive for his good on the very best side — in all that is possible — and may the Good Hashem complete for him for good.

aligned_segments.he: וְאוֹדוֹת מַה שֶּׁכָּתַבְתָּ לִמְחוּתָּנְךָ שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, שֶׁיַּקְדִּים הַנִּשּׂוּאִין מֵהַזְּמַן הֻגְבָּל בְּהַתְּנָאִים, כְּבָר הֵשִׁיב לְךָ שֶׁהוּא דָּבָר שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר, וּכְבָר הָיָה בְּבֵיתִי וְהִתְנַצֵּל עַצְמוֹ הַרְבֵּה, וְאָמַר שֶׁבַּזְּמַן הַמֻגְבָּל יַעֲשֶׂה הַנִּשּׂוּאִין בְּעֶזְרַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, וְאֶפְשָׁר יַקְדִּים עַצְמוֹ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בְּחֹדֶשׁ אֱלוּל הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, וְדַעְתִי הוּא שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּלִי תֵּרוּץ לְפֹה עַל חַג הַשָּׁבוּעוֹת הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, וְאָז יֻגְמַר הַכֹּל בְּכִי טוֹבָה, וְגַם הַסַּךְ חֲמִשִּׁים רוּבָּל שֶׁכְּבָר סִלֵּק מֻנָּח הַשְּׁלִישׁוּת בִּידֵי מִבְטוֹחַ גָּדוֹל, אַךְ כְּבָר הִגִּיעַ הַזְמַן פֵּרָעוֹן וַאֲנִי אֵינִי רוֹצֶה עוֹד לַעֲסֹק בָּזֶה וְאֵינִי רוֹצֶה לְהַשְׁלִישׁ הַשְּׁלִישׁוּת, עַד שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּעַצְמְךָ וְתַשְׁלִישׁ אֵצֶל מִי שֶׁתִּרְצֶה, הֵן עַל כָּל אֵלֶּה אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי עַתָּה לְהַרְחִיב הַדִּבּוּר רַק תִּרְאֶה לְקַיֵּם דְּבָרַי הַנַּ"ל, לִשְׁלֹחַ לִי מָעוֹת מֵאִתְּךָ אוֹ מֵאֲחֵרִים כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁתּוּכַל, וְאַחַר־כָּךְ תְּזָרֵז עַצְמְךָ לְהָכִין עַצְמֶךָ בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁתָּבוֹא לְפֹה עַל חַג הַשָּׁבוּעוֹת הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה וְיִהְיֶה טוֹב לְפָנֶיךָ בְּכָל הָאֳפָנִים בְּגוּף וְנֶפֶשׁ וּמָמוֹן.
aligned_segments.en: And regarding what he wrote to his son-in-law — may he live — to advance the wedding from the time fixed in the tennaim: he has already replied to him that it is impossible — and already he was in his house and made many excuses — and said that at the fixed time he will make the wedding with Hashem's help — and perhaps he will advance himself so that it will be in the month of Elul coming upon them for good. And his mind is that he should come without excuse here for the holy festival of Shavuos coming upon them for good — and then everything will be completed for the best.

aligned_segments.he: וּבְעִנְיַן טוֹבַת הַזּוּג שֶׁיִּחְיוּ, וּבַעַל הַיְשׁוּעוֹת וְהַנֶּחָמוֹת יְנַחֵם וְיוֹשִׁיעַ אוֹתְךָ בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת וְרוּחָנִיּוּת בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁתִּזְכֶּה לִבְרֹחַ וּלְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ מִכָּל מַה שֶּׁעוֹבֵר עָלֶיךָ עַד שֶׁיִּתְהַפֵּךְ הַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה.
aligned_segments.en: And the sum of fifty rubles — that he already paid — one third is held in trust by a great guarantor — but the time of payment has already arrived — and he no longer wants to deal with this — and he does not want to place the deposit — until he comes himself and places it with whom he wishes. On all these matters there are no words in his tongue now to extend the conversation — only let him see to fulfil the above-mentioned words — to send him money from himself or from others — as much as he can — and afterwards hurry to prepare himself in a way that he comes here for the holy festival of Shavuos — and it will be good before him in all ways — in body and soul and money. And in the matter of the good of the couple — may they live — and may the Master of salvations and consolations console and save him in the physical and the spiritual — in a way that he merits to flee and to draw close to Him Yisborach — from all that passes over him — until all is turned to good.

aligned_segments.he: וְיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה הַרְבֵּה לְדַבֵּר אַךְ אֵין הַזְּמַן וְהַיְרִיעָה מַסְפֶּקֶת,, וְגַם כִּי אֲנִי מְצַפֶּה שֶׁתָּבוֹא בְּעַצְמְךָ אִם יִרְצֶה הַשֵּׁם כַּנַּ"ל,
aligned_segments.en: And there is much much to speak about this — but the time and the page do not suffice.

aligned_segments.he: וְאָז פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים נְדַבֵּר בִּישׁוּעוֹת ה' כְּכָל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲמֹס לָנוּ חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא תָמְנוּ וְכוּ' נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: And he is hoping that he will come himself — if Hashem wills — as above — and then face to face they will speak in the salvations of Hashem — as much as His chesed and His wonders will bestow upon them — which have not ceased — nagila v'nismecha bishu'aso.

aligned_segments.he: דִּבְרֵי אוֹהֲבוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת לָנֶצַח וּמְצַפֶּה לִתְשׁוּבָתוֹ תְּחִלָּה וְאַחַר כָּךְ לִרְאוֹתוֹ מְהֵרָה בְּשִׂמְחָה.
aligned_segments.en: The words of one who loves him in truth forever — and awaits his response first — and afterwards to see him quickly in joy.

aligned_segments.he: נָתָן מִבְּרֶסְלֶב
aligned_segments.en: Nussun of Breslov.

aligned_segments.he: וְשָׁלוֹם רַב לְכָל בְּנֵי־בֵיתוֹ וְלִבְנוֹ הֶחָתָן שֶׁיִּחְיֶה,, וּלְחוֹתְנוֹ יְדִידִי נֵרוֹ יָאִיר,, גַּם הוּא יְקַיֵּם לִשְׁלֹחַ אֵיזֶה סַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתַבְתִּי בָּאִגֶּרֶת הַקָּדוּם,
aligned_segments.en: And great peace to all his household and to his son the bridegroom — may he live. And to his father-in-law his dear friend — may his light shine — also he should fulfil to send some sum as he wrote in the earlier letter. And peace to all the precious anshei sh'lomaynu with great love. All that he sends — let him send only to the congregation of Tultchin — to his son Rabbi Yitzchok — may he live. And also this letter is being sent to Tultchin — so that it should certainly arrive in their hands — with Hashem's help.

aligned_segments.he: וְשָׁלוֹם לְכָל אַנְשֵׁי־שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ הַיְקָרִים בְּאַהֲבָה רַבָּה,, כָּל מַה שֶּׁיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׁלַח רַק לִקְהִלַּת טוּלְטְשִׁין לִבְנִי רַבִּי יִצְחָק שֶׁיִּחְיֶה,
aligned_segments.en: Overview: Written to one of the anshei sh'lomaynu — beginning missing — 5601. He extends his peace with great love. Before Pesach he sent him a letter at some length — and afterwards received his letter via his son-in-law Rabbi Yoel. He wonders that he received his letter only once — and because of this he held back from extending his hand to him for good. And also because in the past winter he was confined to bed in Uman for more than five weeks — and afterwards he was in Tirahowitz — and on the road for more than seven weeks — and saw no further letter from him there. And his father — their dear friend — his eyes were longing for his letters — and his hope was disappointed — and in truth he is not fulfilling his obligation to his father in this matter at all.

aligned_segments.he: וְגַם הָאִגֶּרֶת הַזֶּה אָנוּ שׁוֹלְחִים לְטוּלְטְשִׁין בִּכְדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בָּטוּחַ שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ לְיָדָם בְּעֶזְרַת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ.
aligned_segments.en: He arrived home close to Purim — and between Purim and Pesach he sent him the above-mentioned letter. Now there is nothing to add — only to fulfil what he wrote — to send him money from himself or from others. And regarding what he wrote about advancing the wedding from the fixed time in the tennaim — it is impossible. His mind is that he should come without excuse here for the holy festival of Shavuos — and then everything will be completed for the best. And he no longer wants to deal with the deposit until he comes himself and places it with whom he wishes. And he is hoping that he will come himself — and face to face they will speak in the salvations of Hashem — nagila v'nismecha bishu'aso.
